title: Jesus Calls the First Disciples
summary: Following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Matthew 4:18-22 and look for how this passage teaches: Following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way.

tell_it: Jesus called fishermen to follow Him. They left their nets and became His disciples.
understand_it: Following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Jesus Calls the First Disciples reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Following Jesus matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Jesus Calls the First Disciples shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way.
teen_explanation: Jesus Calls the First Disciples gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when following jesus is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What did Jesus say to the fishermen?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Follow Me. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Matthew 4:19 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Jesus Calls the First Disciples?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Follow Me Path
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Jesus Calls the First Disciples. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
